recommendation.headline: TVS iQube, with low confidence
recommendation.summary: Best fit among documented options for comfort and brand stability, but evidence on reliability, real range and service is thin.

reasons.text: Rated a step above Chetak as comfortable, easy city commuter
TVS kept stable sales while Ola struggled

tradeoffs.text: Range figures are claimed, not measured in Bengaluru
Ather is cramped for tall riders but handles best

alternatives.when: You are under about 5ft 10in and value handling
You value ride quality and a local dealer is close

caveats: Sources are 2022 Mumbai tests and 2024 news
No source gives per-brand Bengaluru service data
